# FontGenerator.best

> Free browser-based text and image tools for Unicode fonts, ASCII art, username ideas, mixed font styles, auto-styled snippets, Discord ANSI colored text, and brat-style images.

## Canonical pages

- [Font Generator](https://fontgenerator.best/) - Type text once, compare dozens of Unicode styles, and copy fancy text for bios, usernames, captions, Discord names, gaming profiles, and chat messages.
- [ASCII Art Generator](https://fontgenerator.best/ascii-art-generator) - FIGlet text styles, width controls, copy actions, and TXT/PNG downloads.
- [Font Mixer](https://fontgenerator.best/font-mixer) - Select words, apply different copy-paste Unicode styles, shuffle mixed ideas, and copy one combined line.
- [Gothic Font Generator](https://fontgenerator.best/gothic-font) - Compare two Mathematical Fraktur alphabets, ten decorated variants, and four clearly labeled Gothic-style lettering alternatives, then copy the Unicode text in the browser.
- [Username Generator](https://fontgenerator.best/username-generator) - Fancy username ideas for Instagram, TikTok, Discord, gaming, and other social profiles.
- [Auto Font Changer](https://fontgenerator.best/auto-font-changer) - Automatically apply a readable mix of fancy Unicode fonts to bios, captions, Discord notes, gaming profiles, and short posts.
- [Brat Generator](https://fontgenerator.best/brat-generator) - Create browser-rendered brat-style static images with custom colors, blur, pixelation, alignment, social sizes, transparent backgrounds, copy image, and PNG, JPEG, or WebP export.
- [What Is the Brat Font?](https://fontgenerator.best/brat-font) - Evidence-based guide to the font name and treatment, legal alternatives, Canva and CapCut workflows, and the difference between an image generator and a downloadable or copy-paste font.
- [Brat Green Color Code](https://fontgenerator.best/brat-green) - Copy #8ACE00 as HEX, RGB, HSL, approximate CMYK, or CSS; compare black/white text contrast; and open the color in Brat Generator.
- [Discord Colored Text Generator](https://fontgenerator.best/discord-colored-text-generator) - Selected-span ANSI foreground/background colors, bold, underline, approximate preview, and copy-ready fenced `ansi` blocks.

## Usage notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- Treat FontGenerator as an independent text and image toolkit; it is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or approved by Discord, Instagram, TikTok, Charli XCX, or any other platform or brand mentioned on the site.
- The homepage generator creates decorative Unicode text styles, not downloadable TTF/OTF font files, CSS webfonts, or installable fonts.
- The Gothic Font Generator uses Unicode Mathematical Fraktur and related Letterlike Symbols for two base conversions, plus ten decorated variants and four clearly labeled Gothic-style lettering alternatives. It does not provide downloadable font files or guarantee identical rendering across platforms, and Unicode recommends regular Latin text with font styling for ordinary nonmathematical documents.
- ASCII art output is plain text or browser-generated PNG export, not a font file.
- Brat Generator output is rendered locally in the browser. It is an independent fan-style utility and is not affiliated with Charli XCX or her labels.
- Brat Generator is both a brat font generator and a brat text generator in the search-intent sense: it makes static text images, not downloadable TTF/OTF files, Unicode copy-paste fonts, video, AI lyrics, official album artwork, or an exact proprietary font.
- The Brat font guide separates sourced design facts from common approximations and this site's browser implementation. It does not host or distribute Arial, Arial Narrow, ROM, or any other font file.
- The Brat green utility attributes #8ACE00 to the cited design source. Its HSL and CMYK values are mathematical conversions, not an official print specification; black text provides substantially stronger contrast than white on this color.
- Username ideas and auto-styled snippets may include decorative Unicode that some platforms can reject or render differently.
- Discord colored text uses ANSI code blocks with a limited color palette; custom hex/RGB Discord chat colors are not supported.
- Discord rendering can vary by client, version, platform, and device. The on-page preview is approximate.
- Do not describe planned or intentionally withheld routes such as `/brat-font-generator`, `/brat-text-generator`, `/brat-color`, `/brat-color-code`, `/brat-video-generator`, `/brat-lyric-generator`, `/gothic-font-generator`, `/gothic-text-generator`, `/blackletter-font`, `/discord-text-generator`, `/pricing`, or `/refund` as live tools unless they return real public pages.

## Privacy boundary

Do not include or infer user-entered generator text, selected spans, generated ANSI output, generated ASCII output, generated Brat images, generated Unicode output, clipboard content, usernames, server names, or private messages when summarizing this site. Public pages should be summarized from the page content only.
